note: Research findings. Unofficial community integrations reverse-engineer vendor cloud APIs; SHALAT has not integrated or tested them yet. Exact model and account/app compatibility must be verified before enabling commands. Spectra is treated as a separate model family/brand label, but may share Tadiran platforms; never assume compatibility across all Spectra models.

officialApps.name: Tornado WIFI
officialApps.models: WIFI-series models from 2018 and later; exact model eligibility must be checked

officialApps.name: Universal WIFI
officialApps.models: Models with built-in Wi-Fi; exact model eligibility must be checked

providers.nextRequirement: Implement a secure cloud connector and verify the exact Tornado model/app/account on a real device before enabling control.

communityIntegration.authentication: Tornado app account email and password; repository README says region USA was verified with Israel deployments
communityIntegration.testedModelEvidence: Community discussion reports ISKA-INV-12 X WIFI EU working; another report for ISKA-INV 16 X WIFI EU noted power/mode issues. Not proof for all Tornado models.
communityIntegration.limitations: Unofficial; cloud service can change; some model variants have reported control bugs. Do not enable until SHALAT tests a real unit.

officialApps.name: MY TADIRAN
officialApps.models: Tadiran air conditioners; older models may require the Smart IR accessory rather than built-in Wi-Fi

officialApps.name: TADIRAN IOT
officialApps.models: Supported mini-central, VRF Box and other listed smart products; check the exact system model

officialApps.name: EWPE SMART
officialApps.models: Selected older Wi-Fi models listed in Tadiran's Wi-Fi manuals

providers.nextRequirement: Implement a secure Cognito/SMS login flow and verify one of the listed models on a real device before enabling control.

communityIntegration.protocol: My Tadiran cloud API via AWS Cognito
communityIntegration.authentication: Phone number registered in My Tadiran plus SMS one-time code; refresh token is used for later sessions
communityIntegration.limitations: Unofficial cloud-only integration; only listed models verified by its maintainer; commands may take up to about 90 seconds to propagate.

officialApps.name: MY TADIRAN / EWPE SMART (model-dependent)
officialApps.models: Only where the exact Spectra model's official documentation explicitly confirms Wi-Fi support; no blanket Spectra compatibility is established.

providers.nextRequirement: Build and verify exact infrared remote profiles for Spectra models. Treat Wi-Fi as unsupported unless the exact model manual and app identify a supported connection method.
providers.researchEvidence: The official Spectra S Plus 10-35 manual marks its Wi-Fi button as inactive. This is model-specific evidence and must not be generalized to every Spectra product. Other Spectra variants require individual manual/app verification.
